questions.text:
Find the exact maximum value of  
\[
\sin x+\cos x+\sin 2x
\]
for real \(x\).

A sinusoid of the form  
\[
y=a\cos(kx-b)+c
\]
has one complete period on \([1,5]\), maximum value \(7\), minimum value \(-1\), and passes through \((1,3)\) and \((3,7)\). Determine one such equation.

Let
\[
f(x)=x-2\sin x\qquad (0\le x\le 2\pi).
\]
Without calculus, determine how many solutions the equation \(f(x)=\pi\) has, and locate each solution exactly if possible.

Find the least positive period of
\[
g(x)=\sin\!\left(\frac{\pi x}{2}\right)+\cos\!\left(\frac{\pi x}{3}\right).
\]

For real \(x\), define
\[
h(x)=\cos x+\cos\left(x+\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)+\cos\left(x+\frac{4\pi}{3}\right).
\]
Evaluate \(h(x)\), and then use the same idea to evaluate
\[
\sin x+\sin\left(x+\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)+\sin\left(x+\frac{4\pi}{3}\right).
\]

questions.text: Find the sum of all real solutions to the equation $x = 2024\pi \sin(x)$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.3 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q2
questions.text: Determine the difference between the absolute maximum and absolute minimum values of the function $f(x) = (\sin x + \cos x)^4$ over the real numbers.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.3 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q3
questions.text: How many real numbers $x$ satisfy the equation $\sin(x) + \cos(x\sqrt{2}) = 2$?

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.3 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text: Find the sum of the absolute maximum and absolute minimum values of the function $f(x) = \cos(2x) - 4\sin(x)$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.3 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text: The function $v(t) = \sin\left(\frac{t}{a}\right) + \cos\left(\frac{t}{b}\right)$, where $a$ and $b$ are relatively prime positive integers, models the combined sound wave of two tuning forks. If the fundamental period of $v(t)$ is $120\pi$, find the minimum possible value of the sum $a + b$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.3 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q6
questions.text: Determine the exact amplitude of the combined sinusoidal wave given by $y = \sin(x) + \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) + \sin\left(x + \frac{2\pi}{3}\right)$.
